notes: The functional check compiles and executes a small x86-64 C fixture, then verifies named symbols, DWARF function metadata and source line mapping; cc must be available.
The check also rejects a stripped fixture. It establishes these operations for the recorded compiler output, not every ELF/DWARF dialect.
Python virtual environments are independent copies. Removing this wrapper removes the distribution, not its containing environment.
usage.summary: Parse ELF headers, sections, symbols, relocations and DWARF debug/line information from Python; inspect compiler output without scraping text tools.
